content: Vikram Singh emailed Krishna Das to outline the payment options and first-premium details for Home Insurance policy HC‑2026‑0459, highlighting a 5% discount for auto-debit payments (reducing the standard ₹12,500 premium to ₹11,875 due by October 15, 2026). Krishna Das replied confirming the choice of the auto-debit option and requested confirmation of setup along with a receipt for the payment.

action_items: Send payment receipt to the customer
